title: Barcelona Walking tour, wine tasting, Tapas dinner by We are GuidesBarcelona
text: Carlota was a wonderful guide.  Her personality and knowledge made the tour outstanding.  She took us to a walking tour, a small wine shop, and a small tapas bar.  It was great to get away from the crowds.  I highly recommend her and her company for a comprehensive tour of Barcelona.
author: thomas_m

title: one of our best, if not the best tour we ever had
text: Joseph, our guide, has an unsurpassed knowledge of the Barcelona culture, history, and the diverse gastronomical/wine choices in the city. He made my wife and I feel very much at home, like his own family. There were no questions that Joseph could not answer. He has a passion for the touring business, .... what an outstanding individual ! Hope you enjoy his tour as much as we did, cheers!
author: olivos63
